    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Detail View Renderer (Desain Seragam dengan GRN)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function loadJournalDetail(journalId, refNo) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/journal.entryCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_lines', id: journalId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    journalDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">Gagal memuat detail jurnal.</div>';
                    journalDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                renderJournalDetailView(res.data || [], refNo);
            },
            failure: function() {
                journalDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
                journalDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderJournalDetailView(rows, refNo) {
        var fmtAmt = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };
        var totalDebit = 0, totalCredit = 0;

        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">Detail Baris Jurnal: ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(refNo || '') + '</h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                   '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0">' +
                   '<thead>' +
                   '<tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left">Kode Akun</th>' +
                   '<th align="left">Nama Akun</th>' +
                   '<th align="left">Journal </th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Debit</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Kredit</th>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   '<tbody>';

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty-msg">Tidak ada baris jurnal.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var debit = parseFloat(r.debit) || 0;
                var credit = parseFloat(r.credit) || 0;
                totalDebit += debit;
                totalCredit += credit;

                html += '<tr class="data-row">' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.account_code || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.account_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.description || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="color:#4ade80; font-weight:bold;">' + (debit ? fmtAmt(debit) : '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="color:#f87171; font-weight:bold;">' + (credit ? fmtAmt(credit) : '-') + '</td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });
        }

        html += '</tbody>' +
                '<tfoot>' +
                '<tr class="total-row">' +
                '<td colspan="3" align="right" class="total-label">TOTAL:</td>' +
                '<td align="right" style="color:#4ade80; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtAmt(totalDebit) + '</td>' +
                '<td align="right" style="color:#f87171; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtAmt(totalCredit) + '</td>' +
                '</tr>' +
                '</tfoot>' +
                '</table>';

        journalDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        journalDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }

    function toggleEditViewButtons() {
        var editBtn = document.getElementById('editData');
        var viewBtn = document.getElementById('viewData');
        if (!dataRecord) return;
        var isDraft = dataRecord.status === 'draft';
        if (editBtn) editBtn.style.display = isDraft ? 'block' : 'none';
        if (viewBtn) viewBtn.style.display = isDraft ? 'none' : 'block';
    }

    function setLineEditable(editable) {
        var cm = lineGrid.getColumnModel();
        for (var i = 0; i < cm.getColumnCount(); i++) {
            if (cm.isHidden(i)) continue;
            cm.setEditable(i, editable);
        }
        var addBtn = document.getElementById('btnAddLine');
        if (addBtn) addBtn.style.display = editable ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
        var saveBtn = document.getElementById('saveEdit');
        if (saveBtn) saveBtn.style.display = editable ? 'block' : 'none';
        fldDate.setDisabled(!editable);
        fldPeriod.setDisabled(!editable);
        fldDesc.setDisabled(!editable);
    }

    function togglePostButton() {
        var btn = document.getElementById('postData');
        if (!btn || !dataRecord) return;
        if (dataRecord.status === 'draft') {
            btn.style.display = 'block';
            btn.innerHTML = '<t>Post</t><i class="material-icons md-22 white">lock</i>';
        } else if (dataRecord.status === 'posted') {
            btn.style.display = 'block';
            btn.innerHTML = '<t>Reverse</t><i class="material-icons md-22 white">undo</i>';
        } else {
            btn.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Line Grid Editor (Form Dialog)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var lineDeleter = new Extensive.grid.ItemDeleter();

    var lineGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        store: lineGridDs,
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true, scrollOffset: 0 },
        height: 220,
        selModel: lineDeleter,
        columns: [
            {
                header: 'Akun', dataIndex: 'account_id', width: 220,
                editor: new myComboField({ store: coaDs, displayField: 'account_name', valueField: 'id' }),
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    return record.get('account_code') ? (record.get('account_code') + ' - ' + record.get('account_name')) : '';
                }
            },
            {
                header: 'Debit', dataIndex: 'debit', width: 110, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }),
                renderer: function (v) { return v ? Ext.util.Format.number(v, '0,000.00') : ''; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Kredit', dataIndex: 'credit', width: 110, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }),
                renderer: function (v) { return v ? Ext.util.Format.number(v, '0,000.00') : ''; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Keterangan', dataIndex: 'description', width: 180,
                editor: new myTextField({}), renderer: CellWrap
            },
            lineDeleter
        ],
        listeners: {
            afteredit: function (e) {
                if (e.field === 'account_id') {
                    var rec = coaDs.getById(e.value);
                    if (rec) {
                        e.record.set('account_code', rec.get('account_code'));
                        e.record.set('account_name', rec.get('account_name'));
                    }
                }
                updateTotals();
            }
        }
    });
    lineGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    document.getElementById('btnAddLine') && (document.getElementById('btnAddLine').onclick = function () {
        lineGridDs.add(new addLineRow({ account_id: null, debit: 0, credit: 0, description: '' }));
    });

    function updateTotals() {
        var totalDebit = 0, totalCredit = 0;
        lineGridDs.each(function (r) {
            totalDebit += parseFloat(r.get('debit')) || 0;
            totalCredit += parseFloat(r.get('credit')) || 0;
        });
        var debitEl = document.getElementById('lblTotalDebit');
        var creditEl = document.getElementById('lblTotalCredit');
        var balanceEl = document.getElementById('lblBalanceStatus');
        if (debitEl) debitEl.innerHTML = Ext.util.Format.number(totalDebit, '0,000.00');
        if (creditEl) creditEl.innerHTML = Ext.util.Format.number(totalCredit, '0,000.00');
        if (balanceEl) {
            var isBalance = Math.abs(totalDebit - totalCredit) < 0.01;
            balanceEl.innerHTML = isBalance ? 'BALANCE' : 'TIDAK BALANCE';
            balanceEl.style.color = isBalance ? '#2e9e4f' : '#c0392b';
        }
    }
    lineGridDs.on('update', updateTotals);
    lineGridDs.on('add', updateTotals);
    lineGridDs.on('remove', updateTotals);
    lineGridDs.on('load', updateTotals);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Editor Form
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fldJournalNo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Jurnal', id: 'ref_no', name: 'ref_no', readOnly: true, emptyText: 'Auto-generate' });
    var fldDate = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal', id: 'journal_date', name: 'journal_date', allowBlank: false, value: new Date() });
    var fldPeriod = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Periode', id: 'period_id', name: 'period_id', hiddenName: 'period_id',
        store: periodDs, displayField: 'period_name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldDesc = new myTextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Keterangan', id: 'description', name: 'description' });
    var fldId = new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 100,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldJournalNo },
            { items: fldDate },
            { items: fldPeriod },
            { columnWidth: 1, items: fldDesc },
            { items: fldId }
        ]
    });
    frmEditor.on('clientvalidation', function (f, valid) { if (!valid) { saveEditDisable(); } else { saveEditEnable(); } });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. Action Handlers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
        if (getFormAccess() == 2 || getFormAccess() == 3 || getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'create';
            lineGridDs.removeAll();
            lineGridDs.add(new addLineRow({ account_id: null, debit: 0, credit: 0, description: '' }));
            lineGridDs.add(new addLineRow({ account_id: null, debit: 0, credit: 0, description: '' }));
            updateTotals();
            setLineEditable(true);
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Tambah Jurnal';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'draft') {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hanya jurnal berstatus Draft yang boleh diedit. Gunakan tombol View untuk melihat detail.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 3 || getFormAccess() == 4) {
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            task = 'update';
            frmEditor.getForm().load({ url: '../php-crud/journal.entryCRD.php', params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' } });
            lineGridDs.load({ params: { id: dataRecord.id } });
            setLineEditable(true);
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Jurnal';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    var viewBtn = document.getElementById('viewData');
    if (viewBtn) {
        viewBtn.onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            task = '';
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            frmEditor.getForm().load({ url: '../php-crud/journal.entryCRD.php', params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' } });
            lineGridDs.load({ params: { id: dataRecord.id } });
            setLineEditable(false);
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Detail Jurnal (' + dataRecord.status.toUpperCase() + ') - Read Only';
        };
    }

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'draft') {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hanya jurnal berstatus Draft yang boleh dihapus.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'delete';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hapus jurnal \'' + dataRecord.ref_no + '\' ?';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus data.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    var postBtn = document.getElementById('postData');
    if (postBtn) {
        postBtn.onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih jurnal terlebih dahulu.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            if (dataRecord.status === 'draft') {
                task = 'post';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Post jurnal \'' + dataRecord.ref_no + '\'? Setelah di-post, jurnal tidak bisa diedit/dihapus lagi.';
            } else if (dataRecord.status === 'posted') {
                task = 'reverse';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Reverse jurnal \'' + dataRecord.ref_no + '\'? Ini akan membuat jurnal koreksi baru dengan debit/kredit dibalik.';
            }
        };
    }

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function (event) {
        window.open("../pdf/journal.php", 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        var totalDebit = 0, totalCredit = 0;
        var arrLines = [];
        lineGridDs.each(function (r) {
            var acc = r.get('account_id');
            var debit = parseFloat(r.get('debit')) || 0;
            var credit = parseFloat(r.get('credit')) || 0;
            if (!acc || (debit === 0 && credit === 0)) return;
            totalDebit += debit;
            totalCredit += credit;
            arrLines.push({ account_id: acc, debit: debit, credit: credit, description: r.get('description') });
        });

        if (arrLines.length < 2) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Jurnal minimal harus punya 2 baris (debit & kredit).';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (Math.abs(totalDebit - totalCredit) > 0.01) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Jurnal tidak balance! Total Debit: ' + totalDebit.toFixed(2) + ', Total Kredit: ' + totalCredit.toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }

        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../php-crud/journal.entryCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: task, arrLines: JSON.stringify(arrLines) },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                journalDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                lineGridDs.removeAll();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message || 'Gagal menyimpan jurnal.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

/* Document      : purchaseinvoice.js 
   Description   : Complete Purchase Invoice JS - Fixed Main Grid Loading & Auto Default Matched */

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();

    // [BARU] Hilangkan background warna default toolbar khusus untuk grid
    // editor detail invoice ini saja (scoped ke #editorFormGrid supaya
    // tidak mempengaruhi toolbar grid lain di halaman lain).
    Ext.util.CSS.createStyleSheet(
        '#editorFormGrid .x-toolbar, #editorFormGrid .x-toolbar td, #editorFormGrid .x-toolbar tr { ' +
        'background: transparent !important; background-image: none !important; border: none !important; }',
        'invoice-grid-tbar-transparent'
    );

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Data Store Main Grid
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var invoiceFields = [
        { name: 'id' },
        { name: 'inv_no' },
        { name: 'supplier_invoice_no' },
        { name: 'invoice_date' },
        { name: 'supplier_id' },
        { name: 'supplier_name' },
        { name: 'status' },
        { name: 'remark' },
        { name: 'total_amount', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'paid_amount', type: 'float' }
    ];

    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: 'php-crud/purchaseinvoiceCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, invoiceFields),
        listeners: {
            // [PERBAIKAN] Tambahkan listener exception/load untuk debugging jika grid kosong
            exception: function(proxy, type, action, options, response, arg) {
                try {
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Error Data', res.message || 'Gagal memuat data main grid.');
                } catch(e) {
                    console.error('Response error:', response.responseText);
                }
            }
        }
    });

    // Store Supplier untuk ComboBox Form Editor
    var supplierDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: 'php-crud/purchaseinvoiceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_supplier' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data' }, [
            { name: 'id' },
            { name: 'name' }
        ])
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Main Grid Panel (Tanpa bbar / Paging Toolbar)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var elGridDiv = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var calcHeight = 380;
    if (elGridDiv && elGridDiv.offsetHeight > 100) {
        calcHeight = elGridDiv.offsetHeight;
    }

    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        store: mainDs,
        height: calcHeight,
        stripeRows: true,
        loadMask: true,
        viewConfig: {
            forceFit: true,
            emptyText: '<div style="padding:20px; text-align:center; color:#94a3b8;">Tidak ada data untuk ditampilkan.</div>' // [PERBAIKAN] Pesan jika data kosong
        },
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. Invoice Internal', dataIndex: 'inv_no', sortable: true },
            { header: 'No. Supp. Invoice', dataIndex: 'supplier_invoice_no', sortable: true },
            { header: 'Tgl Invoice', dataIndex: 'invoice_date', sortable: true },
            { header: 'Supplier', dataIndex: 'supplier_name', sortable: true },
            { 
                header: 'Total Nilai (Rp)', 
                dataIndex: 'total_amount', 
                align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) {
                    return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00');
                }
            },
            { header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', align: 'center' },
            { header: 'Keterangan', dataIndex: 'remark' }
        ]
    });

    mainDs.load();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Container Panel Detail Bawah (Main View)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var payDtlDiv = document.createElement('div');
    payDtlDiv.id = 'payDtlContainer';
    payDtlDiv.className = 'detail-panel-container';
    payDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';

    if (elGridDiv && elGridDiv.parentNode) {
        elGridDiv.parentNode.insertBefore(payDtlDiv, elGridDiv.nextSibling);
    }

    function loadInvoiceDetailPanel(invoiceId, invoiceNo, supplierId) {
        if (!invoiceId) return;

        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: 'php-crud/purchaseinvoiceCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { 
                task: 'read_invoice_detail', 
                invoice_id: invoiceId,
                supplier_id: supplierId || 0
            },
            success: function (response) {
                try {
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                    if (!res.success) {
                        payDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red; padding:10px;">Gagal memuat detail invoice.</div>';
                        payDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                        return;
                    }
                    renderInvoiceDetailPanel(res.data || [], invoiceNo);
                } catch (e) {
                    payDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red; padding:10px;">Error parsing data dari server.</div>';
                    payDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                }
            },
            failure: function () {
                payDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red; padding:10px;">Gagal terhubung ke server backend.</div>';
                payDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderInvoiceDetailPanel(rows, invoiceNo) {
        var fmtAmt = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };
        var fmtQty = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };

        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title" style="margin:10px 0 5px 0; font-size:14px; color:#38bdf8;">Detail Match GRN / Item Invoice: ' +
                   Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(invoiceNo || '') + '</h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" style="border:0; border-top:1px solid #334155; margin-bottom:10px;" />' +
                   '<table id="payTable" class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="6" style="border-collapse:collapse; color:#f8fafc; font-size:12px;">' +
                   '<thead>' +
                   '<tr class="header-row" style="background-color:#1e293b; color:#94a3b8;">' +
                   '<th align="left">No. Ref GRN</th>' +
                   '<th align="left">Item / Ref</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Qty</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Harga Satuan</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Total Subtotal</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Nominal Matched</th>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   '<tbody>';

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:15px; text-align:center; color:#94a3b8;">Belum ada rincian GRN/Item terhubung untuk invoice ini.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            var grandTotal = 0;
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var matched = parseFloat(r.matched_amount_this_invoice || r.matched_amount || r.subtotal || r.amount || 0);
                var grnTotal = parseFloat(r.grn_total || r.subtotal || 0);
                grandTotal += matched;

                html += '<tr class="data-row" style="border-bottom:1px solid #334155;">' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.grn_ref_no || r.ref_no || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.item_name || r.remark || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtQty(r.qty_received) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(r.unit_cost) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(grnTotal) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="color:#38bdf8; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtAmt(matched) + '</td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });

            html += '<tr class="footer-row" style="background-color:#0f172a; font-weight:bold;">' +
                    '<td colspan="5" align="right" style="padding:8px;">TOTAL INVOICE:</td>' +
                    '<td align="right" style="color:#22c55e;">' + fmtAmt(grandTotal) + '</td>' +
                    '</tr>';
        }
        html += '</tbody></table>';

        payDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        payDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }

    gridMain.on('rowclick', function (grid, rowIndex) {
        var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
        if (rec) {
            dataRecord = rec.data;
            if (typeof mainBtnEnable === 'function') mainBtnEnable('#editData');
            if (typeof mainBtnEnable === 'function') mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
            
            loadInvoiceDetailPanel(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.inv_no, dataRecord.supplier_id);
        }
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Form Editor & Grid Editor Detail Setup
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fldId = new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true });
    var fldInvNo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Ref Dokumen', id: 'inv_no', name: 'inv_no', allowBlank: true, readOnly: true, disabled: true, emptyText: 'Otomatis oleh sistem', width: 200 });
    var fldSuppInvNo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Supp. Invoice', id: 'supplier_invoice_no', name: 'supplier_invoice_no', allowBlank: false, width: 200 });
    var fldInvDate = new Ext.form.DateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Invoice', id: 'invoice_date', name: 'invoice_date', format: 'Y-m-d', width: 140, allowBlank: false });
    var fldSupplier = new myComboField({ fieldLabel: 'Supplier', id: 'supplier_id', name: 'supplier_id', hiddenName: 'supplier_id', store: supplierDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id', mode: 'remote', triggerAction: 'all', width: 200, allowBlank: false });
    var fldRemark = new Ext.form.TextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Keterangan', id: 'remark', name: 'remark', width: 200, height: 45 });

    // [BARU] Begitu supplier dipilih, otomatis tarik semua GRN supplier itu
    // yang belum pernah di-invoice-kan, langsung jadi baris di grid detail.
    // Default nominal matched = qty_received x unit_cost, sama seperti Add Item manual.
    function autoLoadAvailableGrn(supplierId) {
        if (!supplierId) return;
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: 'php-crud/purchaseinvoiceCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_available_grn', supplier_id: supplierId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res;
                try {
                    res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                } catch (e) {
                    return;
                }
                if (!res.success) return;

                Ext.each(res.data || [], function (g) {
                    var already = false;
                    gridEditorInvoiceDs.each(function (r) {
                        if (r.get('grn_hdr_id') === g.grn_hdr_id) already = true;
                    });
                    if (already) return;

                    var qty = parseFloat(g.qty_received || 0);
                    var price = parseFloat(g.unit_cost || 0);
                    var remaining = parseFloat(g.remaining || 0);

                    var NewItem = gridEditorInvoiceDs.recordType;
                    var newRecord = new NewItem({
                        id: 0,
                        invoice_hdr_id: 0,
                        grn_hdr_id: g.grn_hdr_id,
                        grn_ref_no: g.grn_ref_no,
                        item_name: g.item_name,
                        qty_received: qty,
                        unit_cost: price,
                        grn_total: g.grn_total,
                        matched_amount: remaining
                    });
                    gridEditorInvoiceDs.add(newRecord);
                });
            },
            failure: function () {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Error', 'Gagal memuat daftar GRN otomatis untuk supplier ini.');
            }
        });
    }

    fldSupplier.on('select', function (combo, record) {
        autoLoadAvailableGrn(record.get('id'));
    });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 120,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: [fldId, fldInvNo, fldSuppInvNo, fldInvDate] },
            { items: [fldSupplier, fldRemark] }
        ]
    });

    var invoiceItemFields = [
        { name: 'id', type: 'int' },
        { name: 'invoice_hdr_id', type: 'int' },
        { name: 'grn_hdr_id', type: 'int' },
        { name: 'grn_ref_no', type: 'string' },
        { name: 'item_name', type: 'string' },
        { name: 'qty_received', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'unit_cost', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'grn_total', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'matched_amount', type: 'float' }
    ];

    var gridEditorInvoiceDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: 'php-crud/purchaseinvoiceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_invoice_detail' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', fields: invoiceItemFields })
    });

    var editorDeleter = new Extensive.grid.ItemDeleter();

    // Store daftar GRN yang bisa dipilih (untuk window picker "Add Item")
    var availableGrnDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: 'php-crud/purchaseinvoiceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_available_grn' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data' }, [
            { name: 'grn_hdr_id', type: 'int' },
            { name: 'grn_ref_no', type: 'string' },
            { name: 'grn_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
            { name: 'item_name', type: 'string' },
            { name: 'qty_received', type: 'float' },
            { name: 'unit_cost', type: 'float' },
            { name: 'grn_total', type: 'float' },
            { name: 'already_matched', type: 'float' },
            { name: 'remaining', type: 'float' }
        ])
    });

    var gridGrnPicker = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: availableGrnDs,
        height: 320,
        width: 640,
        stripeRows: true,
        loadMask: true,
        viewConfig: {
            forceFit: true,
            emptyText: '<div style="padding:20px; text-align:center; color:#94a3b8;">Tidak ada GRN yang tersedia untuk supplier ini.</div>'
        },
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. Ref GRN', dataIndex: 'grn_ref_no', width: 100 },
            { header: 'Tgl GRN', dataIndex: 'grn_date', width: 85, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('Y-m-d') },
            { header: 'Item', dataIndex: 'item_name', width: 150 },
            { header: 'Total GRN', dataIndex: 'grn_total', width: 90, align: 'right', renderer: format_number },
            { header: 'Sudah Di-invoice', dataIndex: 'already_matched', width: 100, align: 'right', renderer: format_number },
            { header: 'Sisa Belum Invoice', dataIndex: 'remaining', width: 110, align: 'right', renderer: format_number, css: 'font-weight:bold;' }
        ]
    });

    var wdwGrnPicker = new Ext.Window({
        title: 'Pilih GRN untuk Di-match',
        width: 660,
        height: 400,
        modal: true,
        closeAction: 'hide',
        layout: 'fit',
        items: [gridGrnPicker],
        buttons: [{
            text: 'Pilih',
            handler: function () {
                var rec = gridGrnPicker.getSelectionModel().getSelected();
                if (!rec) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Silakan pilih salah satu GRN.');
                    return;
                }

                // Cegah GRN yang sama ditambahkan dua kali ke invoice yang sama
                var already = false;
                gridEditorInvoiceDs.each(function (r) {
                    if (r.get('grn_hdr_id') === rec.get('grn_hdr_id')) already = true;
                });
                if (already) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'GRN ini sudah ditambahkan ke invoice.');
                    return;
                }

                var qty = parseFloat(rec.get('qty_received') || 0);
                var price = parseFloat(rec.get('unit_cost') || 0);
                var remaining = parseFloat(rec.get('remaining') || 0);

                var NewItem = gridEditorInvoiceDs.recordType;
                var newRecord = new NewItem({
                    id: 0,
                    invoice_hdr_id: 0,
                    grn_hdr_id: rec.get('grn_hdr_id'),
                    grn_ref_no: rec.get('grn_ref_no'),
                    item_name: rec.get('item_name'),
                    qty_received: qty,
                    unit_cost: price,
                    grn_total: rec.get('grn_total'),
                    // [FIX] Nominal matched default = sisa yang belum di-invoice
                    // (untuk GRN baru = qty x harga = sama dengan grn_total)
                    matched_amount: remaining
                });
                gridEditorInvoiceDs.add(newRecord);

                wdwGrnPicker.hide();
            }
        }, {
            text: 'Batal',
            handler: function () { wdwGrnPicker.hide(); }
        }]
    });

    var gridEditorInvoice = new stdGridEditor({
        id: 'gridEditorInvoice',
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        store: gridEditorInvoiceDs,
        selModel: editorDeleter,
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. Ref GRN', dataIndex: 'grn_ref_no', width: 130, align: 'left' },
            { header: 'Item / Material', dataIndex: 'item_name', width: 200, align: 'left' },
            { header: 'Qty', dataIndex: 'qty_received', width: 80, align: 'right', renderer: format_number },
            { header: 'Harga Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit_cost', width: 100, align: 'right', renderer: format_number },
            { 
                header: 'Nominal Matched', 
                dataIndex: 'matched_amount', 
                width: 120, 
                align: 'right', 
                renderer: format_number,
                editor: new Ext.form.NumberField(),
                css: cssGridEditColumn 
            },
            editorDeleter,
            { dataIndex: 'id', hidden: true },
            { dataIndex: 'invoice_hdr_id', hidden: true },
            { dataIndex: 'grn_hdr_id', hidden: true }
        ],
        tbar: [
            '<div id="gridHeaderText">Rincian Item / GRN</div>',
            { xtype: 'tbfill' },
            { 
                text: '&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Add Item&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;', 
                ctCls: 'field-button green-field-button', 
                id: 'btnAddInvoiceItem', 
                handler: function() {
                    var supplierId = fldSupplier.getValue();
                    if (!supplierId) {
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih supplier terlebih dahulu sebelum menambah item.');
                        return;
                    }
                    availableGrnDs.load({ params: { supplier_id: supplierId } });
                    wdwGrnPicker.show();
                } 
            }
        ],
        listeners: {
            // [PERBAIKAN] Otomatis set default nominal matched = qty_received * unit_cost jika kosong/0
            render: function(grid) {
                grid.getStore().on('load', function(store) {
                    store.each(function(record) {
                        var currentMatched = record.get('matched_amount');
                        if (!currentMatched || currentMatched === 0) {
                            var qty = parseFloat(record.get('qty_received') || 0);
                            var price = parseFloat(record.get('unit_cost') || 0);
                            record.set('matched_amount', qty * price);
                        }
                    });
                });
            }
        }
    });
    gridEditorInvoice.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    function setInvoiceGridEditorHeight() {
        var editorFormHeight = $('#editorForm').height() || 400;
        var headerHeight = $('#editorFormHeader').height() || 50;
        var mainFormHeight = $('#editorFormMain').height() || 150;
        var computedHeight = editorFormHeight - headerHeight - mainFormHeight - 20;
        
        if (computedHeight > 150) {
            gridEditorInvoice.setHeight(computedHeight);
        }
    }

    function showWindow(titleText) {
        var wdw = document.getElementById('editorWdw');
        if (wdw) wdw.style.display = 'block';
        if (document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText')) {
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;' + titleText;
        }
        setInvoiceGridEditorHeight();
        // [FIX] Typo lama: id komponennya 'frmEditor', bukan 'frmGridEditor'
        // (yang tidak pernah ada) -> Ext.getCmp() balik undefined -> crash di .doLayout()
        var frmCmp = Ext.getCmp('frmEditor');
        if (frmCmp) frmCmp.doLayout();
    }

    function hideWindow() {
        var wdw = document.getElementById('editorWdw');
        if (wdw) wdw.style.display = 'none';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Action Handlers (Add, Edit, Delete, Save, Discard)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    if (Ext.get('addData')) {
        Ext.get('addData').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            task = 'create';
            dataRecord = null;
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            supplierDs.load();
            gridEditorInvoiceDs.load({ params: { invoice_id: 0 } });
            showWindow('Tambah Purchase Invoice');
        });
    }

    if (Ext.get('editData')) {
        Ext.get('editData').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Silakan pilih data invoice terlebih dahulu.');
                return;
            }
            task = 'update';
            supplierDs.load({
                callback: function() {
                    frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                    frmEditor.getForm().setValues(dataRecord);
                    gridEditorInvoiceDs.load({ params: { invoice_id: dataRecord.id } });
                    showWindow('Edit Purchase Invoice');
                }
            });
        });
    }

    if (Ext.get('deleteData')) {
        Ext.get('deleteData').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Silakan pilih data invoice terlebih dahulu.');
                return;
            }

            Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi', 'Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus invoice ' + dataRecord.inv_no + '?', function (btn) {
                if (btn === 'yes') {
                    Ext.Ajax.request({
                        url: 'php-crud/purchaseinvoiceCRD.php',
                        method: 'POST',
                        params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                        success: function (response) {
                            var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                            if (res.success) {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', 'Data invoice berhasil dihapus.');
                                mainDs.reload();
                                payDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                                dataRecord = null;
                                if (typeof mainBtnDisable === 'function') {
                                    mainBtnDisable('#editData');
                                    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
                                }
                            } else {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Gagal menghapus data.');
                            }
                        },
                        failure: function () {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Error', 'Gagal terhubung ke server.');
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        });
    }

    if (Ext.get('saveEdit')) {
        Ext.get('saveEdit').on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            if (!frmEditor.getForm().isValid()) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Mohon lengkapi semua field yang wajib diisi.');
                return;
            }

            // [PERBAIKAN] Menghentikan mode edit aktif pada grid agar nilai sel terakhir ikut tersimpan di store
            if (gridEditorInvoice.stopEditing) {
                gridEditorInvoice.stopEditing();
            }

            // [PERBAIKAN] Menampung seluruh data row grid editor ke dalam array objek JavaScript
            var detailRecords = [];
            gridEditorInvoiceDs.each(function(record) {
                detailRecords.push(record.data);
            });

            // [PERBAIKAN] Kirim data form beserta detail grid yang sudah di-encode ke format JSON
            frmEditor.getForm().submit({
                url: 'php-crud/purchaseinvoiceCRD.php',
                params: { 
                    task: task,
                    invoice_details: Ext.encode(detailRecords) 
                },
                waitMsg: 'Menyimpan data...',
                success: function (form, action) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', 'Data invoice berhasil disimpan.');
                    hideWindow();
                    mainDs.reload();
                    payDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                },
                failure: function (form, action) {
                    var msg = action.result ? action.result.message : 'Gagal menyimpan data.';
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', msg);
                }
            });
        });
    }

    var btnDiscard = Ext.get('discardEdit') || Ext.select('#editorWdw .x-tool-close');
    if (btnDiscard) {
        btnDiscard.on('click', function (e) {
            if (e) e.stopEvent();
            hideWindow();
        });
    }

    var wdwInit = document.getElementById('editorWdw');
    if (wdwInit) wdwInit.style.display = 'none';
});

/*
  Document      : Purchase Return (Retur Pembelian) - Frontend Logic
  Depends on    : ExtJS 3.4, std-framework
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/purchase.returnCRD.php

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // DOM Helpers (Safe against null elements)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function setDisplay(id, val) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = val;
    }

    function setHtml(id, html) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function CellWrap(val) {
        return '<div style="white-space:normal !important; word-wrap:break-word;">' + (val || '') + '</div>';
    }

    function editDataEnable() {
        var el = document.getElementById('editData');
        if (el) {
            el.disabled = false;
            Ext.fly(el).removeClass('x-item-disabled');
        }
    }
    function editDataDisable() {
        var el = document.getElementById('editData');
        if (el) {
            el.disabled = true;
            Ext.fly(el).addClass('x-item-disabled');
        }
    }
    function mainBtnEnable(id) {
        var el = document.querySelector(id);
        if (el) {
            el.disabled = false;
            Ext.fly(el).removeClass('x-item-disabled');
        }
    }
    function mainBtnDisable(id) {
        var el = document.querySelector(id);
        if (el) {
            el.disabled = true;
            Ext.fly(el).addClass('x-item-disabled');
        }
    }

    var getFormAccess = (function () {
        return function () {
            if (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') return parseInt(formAccess, 10);
            if (typeof FormAccess !== 'undefined') return parseInt(FormAccess, 10);
            if (typeof window.formAccess !== 'undefined') return parseInt(window.formAccess, 10);
            if (typeof window.FormAccess !== 'undefined') return parseInt(window.FormAccess, 10);
            return 7;
        };
    })();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Fields & Stores
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var returnField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'return_no' }, { name: 'return_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'wh_receiving_hdr_id' }, { name: 'wh_rcv_ref_no' },
        { name: 'grn_hdr_id' }, { name: 'grn_ref_no' },
        { name: 'warehouse_id' }, { name: 'warehouse_name' },
        { name: 'supplier_id' }, { name: 'supplier_name' },
        { name: 'posting_basis' }, { name: 'status' }, { name: 'reason' }, { name: 'remark' },
        { name: 'total_qty', type: 'float' }, { name: 'total_amount', type: 'float' }
    ];

    var itemField = [
        { name: 'wh_rcv_dtl_id' }, { name: 'wh_receiving_hdr_id' }, { name: 'grn_dtl_id' },
        { name: 'item_id' }, { name: 'item_name' },
        { name: 'qty_received', type: 'float' }, { name: 'unit_cost', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'grade_id' }, { name: 'warehouse_id' },
        { name: 'qty_returned', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'qty_returnable', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'qty_returned_this_return', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'qty_input', type: 'float' }
    ];

    var whRcvField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'ref_no' }, { name: 'received_date' },
        { name: 'grn_hdr_id' }, { name: 'grn_ref_no' },
        { name: 'warehouse_id' }, { name: 'warehouse_name' },
        { name: 'supplier_id' }, { name: 'supplier_name' }
    ];

    var whRcvDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/purchase.returnCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_wh_rcv' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, whRcvField)
    });
    whRcvDs.load();

    var itemGridDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/purchase.returnCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_wh_rcv_items' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, itemField),
        listeners: {
            load: function (store) {
                store.each(function (r) {
                    r.set('qty_input', r.get('qty_returned_this_return') || 0);
                });
                updateReturnTotalLabel();
            }
        }
    });

    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/purchase.returnCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, returnField)
    });
    mainDs.load();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Main Grid & Detail Panel Container setup
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var mainGridEl = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var GridDtlHeight = mainGridEl ? (maxGridHeight(mainGridEl)) : 400;
    var mainHeight = Math.round(GridDtlHeight - (GridDtlHeight * 0.5));
    var detailHeight = (GridDtlHeight - mainHeight);

    var returnDtlDiv = document.getElementById('divReturnDetail');
    if (!returnDtlDiv) {
        returnDtlDiv = document.createElement('div');
        returnDtlDiv.id = 'divReturnDetail';
        returnDtlDiv.className = 'detail-panel-container';
        returnDtlDiv.style.margin = '15px 0';
        returnDtlDiv.style.padding = '12px 15px';
        returnDtlDiv.style.background = 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85)';
        returnDtlDiv.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';
        returnDtlDiv.style.borderRadius = '6px';
        returnDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';

        if (mainGridEl && mainGridEl.parentNode) {
            mainGridEl.parentNode.insertBefore(returnDtlDiv, mainGridEl.nextSibling);
        }
    }

    var gridMain = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height: detailHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. Retur', dataIndex: 'return_no', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Tanggal', dataIndex: 'return_date', width: 90, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            { header: 'Ref. RCV W/H', dataIndex: 'wh_rcv_ref_no', width: 120, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'No. GRN', dataIndex: 'grn_ref_no', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Supplier', dataIndex: 'supplier_name', width: 150, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Gudang', dataIndex: 'warehouse_name', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
            {
                header: 'Perlakuan Jurnal', dataIndex: 'posting_basis', width: 140, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) {
                    return v === 'accounts_payable'
                        ? '<span style="color:#f39c12;font-weight:bold;">Kurangi Hutang</span>'
                        : '<span style="color:#3498db;font-weight:bold;">Kurangi GRN Clearing</span>';
                }
            },
            {
                header: 'Total Nilai', dataIndex: 'total_amount', width: 120, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00') + '</b>'; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 90, align: 'center',
                renderer: function (v) {
                    return v === 'cancelled'
                        ? '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-weight:bold;">Cancelled</span>'
                        : '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">Posted</span>';
                }
            },
            { header: 'Alasan', dataIndex: 'reason', width: 150, renderer: CellWrap }
        ],
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true },
        loadMask: true,
        listeners: {
            rowclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                var rec = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex);
                if (rec) {
                    dataRecord = rec.data;
                    mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                    editDataEnable();
                    loadReturnDetail(dataRecord.id, dataRecord.return_no);
                }
            }
        }
    });
    editDataDisable();
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Detail View Renderer
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function loadReturnDetail(returnId, returnNo) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/purchase.returnCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_return_items', return_id: returnId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    setHtml('divReturnDetail', '<div style="color:yellow;padding:10px;">Gagal memuat detail retur.</div>');
                    setDisplay('divReturnDetail', 'block');
                    return;
                }
                renderReturnDetailView(res.data || [], returnNo);
            },
            failure: function () {
                setHtml('divReturnDetail', '<div style="color:red;padding:10px;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>');
                setDisplay('divReturnDetail', 'block');
            }
        });
    }

    function renderReturnDetailView(rows, returnNo) {
        var fmtQty = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); };
        var fmtAmt = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };

        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title" style="margin:5px 0 10px 0; font-size:14px; color:#38bdf8;">Rincian Item Retur Pembelian: ' +
                   Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(returnNo || '') + '</h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" style="border:0; border-top:1px solid #334155; margin-bottom:10px;" />' +
                   '<table id="returnDtlTable" class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="6" style="border-collapse:collapse; color:#f8fafc; font-size:12.5px;">' +
                   '<thead>' +
                   '<tr class="header-row" style="background-color:#1e293b; color:#94a3b8;">' +
                   '<th align="left" style="padding:8px;">Nama Item / Barang</th>' +
                   '<th align="right" style="padding:8px;">Qty Terima W/H</th>' +
                   '<th align="right" style="padding:8px;">Qty Diretur</th>' +
                   '<th align="right" style="padding:8px;">Harga Satuan</th>' +
                   '<th align="right" style="padding:8px;">Subtotal Retur</th>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   '<tbody>';

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="5" style="padding:15px; text-align:center; color:#94a3b8;">Tidak ada rincian item untuk retur ini.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            var grandTotal = 0;
            var grandQty = 0;
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var qty = parseFloat(r.qty_returned) || 0;
                var cost = parseFloat(r.unit_cost) || 0;
                var subtotal = qty * cost;
                grandTotal += subtotal;
                grandQty += qty;

                html += '<tr class="data-row" style="border-bottom:1px solid #334155;">' +
                        '<td align="left" style="padding:6px 8px;">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.item_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="padding:6px 8px; color:#94a3b8;">' + fmtQty(r.qty_received) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="padding:6px 8px; color:#f87171; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtQty(qty) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="padding:6px 8px;">' + fmtAmt(cost) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="padding:6px 8px; color:#38bdf8; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtAmt(subtotal) + '</td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });

            html += '<tr class="footer-row" style="background-color:#0f172a; font-weight:bold;">' +
                    '<td colspan="2" align="right" style="padding:8px; color:#94a3b8;">TOTAL RETUR:</td>' +
                    '<td align="right" style="padding:8px; color:#f87171;">' + fmtQty(grandQty) + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right" style="padding:8px;"></td>' +
                    '<td align="right" style="padding:8px; color:#22c55e; font-size:13px;">' + fmtAmt(grandTotal) + '</td>' +
                    '</tr>';
        }
        html += '</tbody></table>';

        returnDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        returnDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Item Grid Editor (Form Dialog)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var itemGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        store: itemGridDs,
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true, scrollOffset: 0 },
        height: 220,
        columns: [
            { header: 'Item', dataIndex: 'item_name', width: 200, renderer: CellWrap },
            {
                header: 'Qty Terima W/H', dataIndex: 'qty_received', width: 120, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Sisa Bisa Retur', dataIndex: 'qty_returnable', width: 120, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Qty Diretur', dataIndex: 'qty_input', width: 130, align: 'right',
                editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 4 }),
                renderer: function (v) { return '<b style="color:#c0392b;">' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000') + '</b>'; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Harga Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit_cost', width: 110, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Subtotal', dataIndex: 'qty_input', width: 130, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    var subtotal = (parseFloat(record.get('qty_input')) || 0) * (parseFloat(record.get('unit_cost')) || 0);
                    return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(subtotal, '0,000.00') + '</b>';
                }
            }
        ],
        listeners: {
            afteredit: function (e) {
                if (e.field === 'qty_input') {
                    var maxQty = parseFloat(e.record.get('qty_returnable')) || 0;
                    var qtyInput = parseFloat(e.value) || 0;
                    if (qtyInput > maxQty) {
                        e.record.set('qty_input', maxQty);
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Qty retur melebihi sisa yang bisa di-retur. Otomatis dibatasi ke ' + Ext.util.Format.number(maxQty, '0,000.0000') + '.');
                    }
                    if (qtyInput < 0) {
                        e.record.set('qty_input', 0);
                    }
                }
                updateReturnTotalLabel();
            }
        }
    });
    itemGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    function updateReturnTotalLabel() {
        var total = 0;
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
            var qty = parseFloat(r.get('qty_input')) || 0;
            var cost = parseFloat(r.get('unit_cost')) || 0;
            total += qty * cost;
        });
        setHtml('lblReturnTotal', Ext.util.Format.number(total, '0,000.00'));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Editor Form Fields
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var fldReturnNo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Retur', id: 'return_no', name: 'return_no', readOnly: true, emptyText: 'Auto-generate' });

    var fldWhRcvHdr = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Penerimaan Gudang', id: 'wh_receiving_hdr_id', name: 'wh_receiving_hdr_id', hiddenName: 'wh_receiving_hdr_id',
        store: whRcvDs, displayField: 'ref_no', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false,
        tpl: new Ext.XTemplate(
            '<tpl for=".">',
            '<div class="x-combo-list-item">',
            '<b>{ref_no}</b> <span style="color:#aaa;">({grn_ref_no})</span><br/>',
            '<small>{supplier_name} ({warehouse_name}) - {received_date}</small>',
            '</div>',
            '</tpl>'
        ),
        listeners: {
            select: function (combo, record) {
                if (fldSupplierIdHidden) fldSupplierIdHidden.setValue(record.get('supplier_id'));
                itemGridDs.load({
                    params: {
                        wh_receiving_hdr_id: record.get('id'),
                        return_id: (task === 'update' && dataRecord) ? dataRecord.id : 0
                    },
                    callback: function () {
                        checkPostingBasisPreview(record.get('grn_hdr_id'), record.get('id'));
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    });

    var fldSupplierIdHidden = new myTextField({ id: 'supplier_id_hidden', name: 'supplier_id', hidden: true });
    var fldReturnDate = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tgl Retur', id: 'return_date', name: 'return_date', allowBlank: false, value: new Date() });
    var fldReason = new myTextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Alasan Retur', id: 'reason', name: 'reason', height: 40 });
    var fldRemark = new myTextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Keterangan', id: 'remark', name: 'remark', height: 40 });

    function checkPostingBasisPreview(grnHdrId, whReceivingHdrId) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/purchase.returnCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: 'preview_posting_basis',
                grn_hdr_id: grnHdrId || 0,
                wh_receiving_hdr_id: whReceivingHdrId || 0
            },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (res.success && res.posting_basis === 'accounts_payable') {
                    setHtml('lblPostingBasis', '<b style="color:#f39c12;">Kurangi Hutang Usaha</b> (GRN sudah di-invoice)');
                } else {
                    setHtml('lblPostingBasis', '<b style="color:#3498db;">Kurangi GRN Clearing</b> (GRN belum di-invoice)');
                }
            }
        });
    }

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 110,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { columnWidth: 0.30, items: fldReturnNo },
            { columnWidth: 0.30, items: fldReturnDate },
            { columnWidth: 0.40, items: fldWhRcvHdr },
            { columnWidth: 0.50, items: fldReason },
            { columnWidth: 0.50, items: fldRemark },
            { items: fldSupplierIdHidden }
        ]
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. CRUD Toolbar Action Handlers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var btnAdd = document.getElementById('addData');
    if (btnAdd) {
        btnAdd.onclick = function () {
            if (getFormAccess() >= 2) {
                task = 'create';
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                itemGridDs.removeAll();
                updateReturnTotalLabel();
                setHtml('lblPostingBasis', '-');
                if (fldWhRcvHdr) fldWhRcvHdr.setDisabled(false);
                setDisplay('editorWdw', 'block');
                setHtml('editorFormHeaderText', '&nbsp;&nbsp;Retur Pembelian Baru');
            }
        };
    }

    var btnEdit = document.getElementById('editData');
    if (btnEdit) {
        btnEdit.onclick = function () {
            task = '';
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data retur yang ingin diedit.');
                return;
            }

            if (getFormAccess() >= 3) {
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                task = 'update';

                if (!whRcvDs.getById(dataRecord.wh_receiving_hdr_id)) {
                    var WhRcvRecord = Ext.data.Record.create(whRcvField);
                    whRcvDs.add(new WhRcvRecord({
                        id: dataRecord.wh_receiving_hdr_id,
                        ref_no: (dataRecord.wh_rcv_ref_no || ('RCV #' + dataRecord.wh_receiving_hdr_id)) + ' (sudah tidak outstanding)',
                        grn_hdr_id: dataRecord.grn_hdr_id,
                        grn_ref_no: dataRecord.grn_ref_no,
                        supplier_id: dataRecord.supplier_id,
                        supplier_name: dataRecord.supplier_name,
                        warehouse_id: dataRecord.warehouse_id,
                        warehouse_name: dataRecord.warehouse_name
                    }, dataRecord.wh_receiving_hdr_id));
                }

                frmEditor.getForm().load({
                    url: '../php-crud/purchase.returnCRD.php',
                    params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' },
                    success: function (form, action) {
                        if (fldWhRcvHdr) fldWhRcvHdr.setDisabled(true);
                        if (fldSupplierIdHidden) fldSupplierIdHidden.setValue(dataRecord.supplier_id);
                        var basisText = dataRecord.posting_basis === 'accounts_payable'
                            ? '<b style="color:#f39c12;">Kurangi Hutang Usaha</b>'
                            : '<b style="color:#3498db;">Kurangi GRN Clearing</b>';
                        setHtml('lblPostingBasis', basisText);

                        itemGridDs.load({
                            params: {
                                wh_receiving_hdr_id: dataRecord.wh_receiving_hdr_id,
                                return_id: dataRecord.id
                            },
                            callback: function () { updateReturnTotalLabel(); }
                        });
                    }
                });

                setDisplay('editorWdw', 'block');
                setHtml('editorFormHeaderText', '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Retur Pembelian');
            } else {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengedit.');
            }
        };
    }

    var btnDelete = document.getElementById('deleteData');
    if (btnDelete) {
        btnDelete.onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data retur yang ingin dihapus.');
                return;
            }
            if (getFormAccess() >= 4) {
                Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi Hapus', 'Hapus retur \'' + dataRecord.return_no + '\'? Jurnal & stok keluar akan dibatalkan otomatis.', function (btn) {
                    if (btn === 'yes') {
                        Ext.Ajax.request({
                            url: '../php-crud/purchase.returnCRD.php',
                            method: 'POST',
                            params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                            success: function (response) {
                                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Informasi', res.message);
                                setDisplay('divReturnDetail', 'none');
                                mainDs.load();
                                whRcvDs.load();
                            },
                            failure: function () {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });
            } else {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses menghapus data.');
            }
        };
    }

    var btnSave = document.getElementById('saveEdit');
    if (btnSave) {
        btnSave.onclick = function () {
            var whReceivingHdrId = fldWhRcvHdr.getValue();
            if (!whReceivingHdrId) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih Penerimaan Gudang (RCV W/H) yang mau diretur terlebih dahulu.');
                return;
            }

            var arrItems = [];
            itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
                var qty = parseFloat(r.get('qty_input')) || 0;
                if (qty > 0) {
                    arrItems.push({
                        wh_rcv_dtl_id: r.get('wh_rcv_dtl_id'),
                        grn_dtl_id: r.get('grn_dtl_id'),
                        item_id: r.get('item_id'),
                        item_name: r.get('item_name'),
                        qty_returned: qty,
                        unit_cost: parseFloat(r.get('unit_cost')) || 0,
                        grade_id: r.get('grade_id') || null,
                        remark: ''
                    });
                }
            });

            if (arrItems.length === 0) {
                Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Minimal 1 item dengan qty retur > 0.');
                return;
            }

            var currentId = (task === 'update' && dataRecord) ? dataRecord.id : null;
            var supplierId = fldSupplierIdHidden ? fldSupplierIdHidden.getValue() : 0;

            frmEditor.getForm().submit({
                url: '../php-crud/purchase.returnCRD.php',
                method: 'POST',
                params: {
                    task: task,
                    id: currentId,
                    wh_receiving_hdr_id: whReceivingHdrId,
                    supplier_id: supplierId,
                    arrItems: JSON.stringify(arrItems)
                },
                waitTitle: 'Menyimpan',
                waitMsg: 'Memproses retur, stok keluar & auto-jurnal...',
                success: function (form, action) {
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message);
                    setDisplay('divReturnDetail', 'none');
                    mainDs.load();
                    whRcvDs.load();
                    setDisplay('editorWdw', 'none');
                },
                failure: function (form, action) {
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
                }
            });
        };
    }

    var btnCloseEditor = document.getElementById('closeEditorForm') || document.getElementById('cancelEdit');
    if (btnCloseEditor) {
        btnCloseEditor.onclick = function () {
            setDisplay('editorWdw', 'none');
        };
    }

    setDisplay('editorWdw', 'none');
});

<script>
  const ENDPOINT = '../../php-crud/paymentCRD.php';

  async function loadGrid() {
    const res = await apiCall(ENDPOINT, 'read');
    const tbody = $('gridBody');
    if (!res.success || !res.data.length) {
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;">Tidak ada data.</td></tr>';
      return;
    }
    tbody.innerHTML = res.data.map(i => `
      <tr>
        <td style="font-family:var(--font-mono); color:var(--gold);">${i.payment_no}</td>
        <td>${i.payment_date}</td>
        <td>${i.customer_name}</td>
        <td>${UIFormat.currency(i.total_amount)}</td>
        <td>${UIFormat.currency(i.deposit_applied)}</td>
        <td>
          <button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onclick="openEdit(${i.id})">Edit</button>
        </td>
      </tr>
    `).join('');
  }

  function openNewModal() {
    $('mainForm').reset();
    UIModal.hideErr('errBox');
    UIModal.show('formOverlay');
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadGrid);
</script>

</body>

## File: ./js/generalledger.js

/*
  Document      : m.generalledger.js
  Description   : General Ledger - Laporan read-only, filter Akun & Periode
                   OPSIONAL. Kalau tidak dipilih, tampilkan semua akun /
                   semua periode, dikelompokkan per akun (GroupingView).
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/generalledgerCRD.php
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "General <em>Ledger</em>";

    ['addData', 'editData', 'deleteData'].forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 0. Buat elemen filter bar & summary secara dinamis
    // ============================================================
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var filterBarDiv = document.createElement('div');
    filterBarDiv.id = 'glFilterBar';
    filterBarDiv.style.padding = '0 10px';
    var summaryDiv = document.createElement('div');
    summaryDiv.id = 'glSummary';
    summaryDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:5px 12px; font-size:13px; color:#ddd; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); margin:0 10px 10px 10px; border-radius:4px;';
    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {

/* Reusable App Engine Core */
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

// Universal API Fetcher
async function apiCall(endpoint, task, payload = {}) {
  try {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('task', task);
    for (const key in payload) {
      if (payload[key] !== null && payload[key] !== undefined) {
        formData.append(key, typeof payload[key] === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(payload[key]) : payload[key]);
      }
    }
    const response = await fetch(endpoint, { method: 'POST', body: formData });
    return await response.json();
  } catch (e) {
    return { success: false, message: 'Gagal terhubung ke server.' };
  }
}

// Universal Modal Controller
const UIModal = {
  show(modalId) { $(modalId)?.classList.add('show'); },
  hide(modalId) { $(modalId)?.classList.remove('show'); },
  showErr(boxId, msg) {
    const box = $(boxId);
    if (box) { box.textContent = msg; box.style.display = 'block'; }
  },
  hideErr(boxId) {
    const box = $(boxId);
    if (box) { box.style.display = 'none'; }
  }
};

// Formatter Utilitas
const UIFormat = {
  currency(val) {
    return Number(val || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 });
  }
};

<?php
/*
    Document        : index.php
    Description     : Halaman Utama / Portal Login Sistem Monitoring Kontraktor & WMS (Theme Matched)
*/

require_once __DIR__ . '/php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION)) { session_start(); }

if (isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) && !is_null($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    //header('Location: views/dashboard.php');
    //exit;
}

$error_msg = '';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $username = trim($_POST['username'] ?? '');
    $password = trim($_POST['password'] ?? '');

    if (!empty($username) && !empty($password)) {
        try {
            $db = new crud();
            
            $stmt = $db->prepare("
                SELECT id, login_name, password, active 
                FROM m_user_system 
                WHERE login_name = :username AND active IS TRUE 
                LIMIT 1
            ");
            $stmt->execute(['username' => $username]);
            $user = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if ($user && (password_verify($password, $user['password']) || md5($password) === $user['password'])) {
                $_SESSION['user_id']    = $user['id'];
                $_SESSION['username']   = $user['login_name'];
                $_SESSION['department'] = $user['department'] ?? 'General';
                $_SESSION['FormAccess'] = 3;

                header('Location: views/dashboard.php');
                exit;
            } else {
                $error_msg = 'Username atau Password salah!';
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $error_msg = 'Terjadi kesalahan koneksi database.';
        }
    } else {
        $error_msg = 'Harap isi username dan password.';
    }
}

/**
 * Copies all the properties of config to obj.
 * @param {Object} obj The receiver of the properties
 * @param {Object} config The source of the properties
 * @param {Object} defaults A different object that will also be applied for default values
 * @return {Object} returns obj
 * @member Ext apply
 */
Ext.apply = function(o, c, defaults){
    // no "this" reference for friendly out of scope calls
    if(defaults){
        Ext.apply(o, defaults);
    }
    if(o && c && typeof c == 'object'){
        for(var p in c){
            o[p] = c[p];
        }
    }
    return o;
};

(function(){
    var idSeed = 0,
        toString = Object.prototype.toString,
        ua = navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase(),
        check = function(r){
            return r.test(ua);

            constructor: emptyFn,
            toString: emptyFn,
            valueOf: emptyFn
        }),
        callOverrideParent = function () {
            var method = callOverrideParent.caller.caller; // skip callParent (our caller)
            return method.$owner.prototype[method.$name].apply(this, arguments);
        };

    if (t.constructor !== emptyFn) {
        nonEnumerables.push('constructor');
    }
    if (t.toString !== emptyFn) {
        nonEnumerables.push('toString');
    }
    if (t.valueOf !== emptyFn) {
        nonEnumerables.push('valueOf');

            // This code is intentionally inlined for the least number of debugger stepping
            return (method = this.callParent.caller) && (method.$previous ||
                ((method = method.$owner ? method : method.caller) &&
                        method.$owner.superclass.self[method.$name])).apply(this, args || noArgs);

        applyIf : function(o, c){

    },
